comment: Two-slab steady conjugate heat transfer: slab A (4C thermo) on [0,L1]x[0,H], slab B (Kratos ConvectionDiffusion) on [L1,L1+L2]x[0,H]. Analytic interface temperature T_if = (TL*k1/L1 + TR*k2/L2)/(k1/L1 + k2/L2); interface flux q = (TL-TR)/(L1/k1 + L2/k2).
comment_paths: fourc_binary and kratos_python are tokens, not paths: scripts/_host_roots.expand() resolves them on whichever machine reads this file. They used to name one person's home directory, which works on one computer and publishes a username.
